card.name: "Has been" in neuroleptic malignant syndrome warnings
card.fires_on: The word "been" in "has been reported in association with", right after the Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) definition in antipsychotic labels.

modes.label: NMS warning sentence
modes.description: "been" after "has" following the NMS definition, just before "reported in association with antipsychotic".
modes.example: A potentially fatal symptom complex sometimes referred to as Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) has<< been>> reported in association with antipsychotic

card.plain: It marks the word "been" in the standard sentence saying neuroleptic malignant syndrome has been reported with antipsychotics.
